what: Budget gate with AO, the lofted car, a 96-pedestrian crowd and the geometry fixes all integrated
caution: The first four attempts at this measurement were invalid and nearly led to a wrong conclusion. Three crashed with "Target page, context or browser has been closed" while sub-agent Chromium instances competed for CPU, and because a crashed harness does not rewrite docs/drive-traffic.json, re-reading that file returned the PREVIOUS run byte-for-byte. Identical numbers across runs are the tell; the check is the artifact mtime and the harness exit code, not the numbers.

contaminatedReading.note: measured under 15 concurrent Chromium instances; not a valid sample

conclusion: No FAIL in five clean runs. Stall median 11.8 ms, p80 12.7, max 12.8 against warn 8 / fail 16. Draw calls 149 median against warn 200 - the 96-ped crowd costs 4 calls and the car gave back 4. Triangles 184.6k against warn 400k, up from 68k, which is the instanced crowd and the car.
